# Story 10.2: Widen the Universe Ex-Date column to fit its content

Status: done

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want the Universe table's Ex-Date column wide enough to show its full editable date input,
So that the value is not truncated and I can read and edit it without guessing.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The `ex_date` column definition in `apps/dms-material/src/app/global/global-universe/global-universe.columns.ts` has its `width` increased from 175 to a value wide enough for the editable date input (230px), so the input renders without truncation.
2. Because base-table renders each cell at `[style.width.px]="column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH"`, the widened definition is reflected in both the Ex-Date header and body cells with no other change required.
3. Story 10.1's red-phase unit assertions are unskipped and green under `nx test dms-material`, with no pre-existing regression in the global-universe specs.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1: Remove `.skip()` markers from Story 10.1's tests and confirm they fail (red)
  - [x] 1.1 Un-skip every `it.skip` added by Story 10.1 in the global-universe spec(s).
  - [x] 1.2 Run `nx test dms-material` and confirm the width assertion FAILS while `ex_date` is still `width: 175`.
- [x] Task 2: Widen the Ex-Date column (AC: #1, #2)
  - [x] 2.1 In `global-universe.columns.ts`, change the `ex_date` entry's `width` from `175` to `230`.
- [x] Task 3: Verify green + no regression (AC: #3)
  - [x] 3.1 Re-run `nx test dms-material`; confirm Story 10.1's assertions pass and no pre-existing global-universe spec regresses.
  - [x] 3.2 Run `nx run dms-material:lint` and the build target; both clean.

## Dev Notes

- Red-phase TDD convention: this story's FIRST task is to remove Story 10.1's `.skip()` markers, confirm red, then implement until green.
- **Single-token change:** only `ex_date.width` changes (175 → 230). The rendered width flows from that value through base-table's `[style.width.px]="column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH"` binding, so no template or SCSS edit is needed.
- **Why 230:** the Ex-Date cell hosts an editable date input (`<dms-editable-date-cell>` / mat-form-field) plus its label affordances; 175 truncates it. 230 gives comfortable headroom for a `MM/DD/YYYY` value with the field's padding and edit affordance. If review finds other narrow columns (the Epic prose says "There may be other places I miss"), extend this story by adding their column definitions' widths here — each is an independent one-token change in its table's column array.
- **No layout regression risk:** widening a single column shifts the horizontal scroll extent of the universe table only; row height (57px) and virtual-scroll itemSize are unaffected.

### Project Structure Notes

- Modify: `apps/dms-material/src/app/global/global-universe/global-universe.columns.ts` (one width value).
- No conflict: additive width increase; no structural or behavioral change beyond the column's rendered width.
